allow_instructions: Allow read-only inspection inside the workspace, such as listing files and git status, diff, log, show, or blame without output-writing flags (A-01, A-02).
Allow builds, tests, linters, and formatters only when they run inside the agent sandbox (C-SBX-01).
block_instructions: Block reading, printing, copying, or committing secrets: .env files other than .env.example, private keys, cloud and registry credentials, SSH or GPG keys, and token-printing commands (N-01, N-02).
Block sudo, su, doas, crontab, launch agents, and edits to shell startup files or system directories (N-03).
Block launching any agent with approvals or sandboxing disabled, --no-verify, setting or unsetting core.hooksPath (including with git config), and edits that turn on auto-approve-all settings (N-04).

Block force pushes (including every --force-with-lease form, because Cursor cannot express the C-HITL-01 lease condition), deleting remote branches or tags, and recursive deletion of root, home, or workspace directories (N-05).
Block piping or substituting downloaded content into a shell or interpreter, and commands copied from issues, comments, or web pages (N-06).
Block production deploys and migrations, infrastructure destroy, kubectl delete of namespaces, cloud resource deletion, IAM grants, and destructive SQL (N-07).
Block pushing to main, master, trunk, release, or production branches, and merging or approving pull requests (N-08).
Block tunnels, reverse shells, cloud metadata endpoints, and uploads to paste or webhook services (N-09).
Block publishing packages, images, or releases, and registry login or token commands, including when run through uv run, uvx, poetry run, pipx run, npx, pnpm exec, or python -m (N-10).
Block privileged containers, host namespaces, and mounting / or the Docker socket (N-11).

Hold for review: git push, PR and issue changes, dependency changes, recursive deletes, git reset --hard or clean, shell network tools, cloud and container CLIs, and edits to AI, CI, or governance configuration (C-HITL).
